description:
Use this when the user asks for an Indian company's disclosed operating figures such as order book, order inflow, capacity or other business KPIs over time.

Returns the operating figures the company disclosed in its filings, each with its date, unit and source, and a `coverage` entry per metric saying whether it was found. `metrics` is a list from: order_book, order_inflow, execution_period, working_capital_days_change, capacity, installed_capacity, planned_capacity, power_capacity, utilisation, commissioning_date, announced_capex, capex_spent, remaining_capex, store_count, inventory, aum, disbursements, net_interest_margin, casa_ratio, average_interest_earning_assets; the default is all of them. `from_date` and `to_date` (ISO) limit the dates and `latest_only=true` gives the newest value of each. `limit` is at most 100 and is applied across metrics in alphabetical order, so name the metrics you need. Values are as disclosed: an order book is never derived from new orders.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query

name: get_company_operating_metrics
